cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our soup bowl said hello. Use the formal greeting; crockery stopped speaking after the Great Washing-Up. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, but keep the butter separate; mixed gifts caused the gravy embargo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's recognition as a nation. Move the plates apart before we accidentally concede its borders.

mechanism: A directs dinner diplomacy, supplies bread and yields a chair while turning the bowl requests into trade history and territorial consequences.
confusable: Unlike simply treating an object politely, each request expands the impossible international system and its past penalties.
comparison: Dinner nations and mixed gifts differ from furniture airspace treaties.
seedUse: D168-b greeting, Great Washing-Up, gravy embargo and borders; S02-b takes real hosting work to sustain participation.
